name: Shichiseki Aster
source:
"I hate having someone else decide for me. A world where I can’t be with the person I love is..."

Subaru’s older sister. Straightforward and strong-willed, which often leads to trouble. She wants to live life as herself.

[Translated from [url=https://www.primula.jpn.com/qualiadelta/chara01.html]the official website[/url].]
